notes: Eight own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin. The Stack page shows five featured partners only (the full marketplace sits behind See All Partners and was not read within the 8-page cap), so Homebase, Birdeye, Procurify, Stessa and ButterflyMX are unverifiable. The resident experience page says FolioSpace is built into AppFolio's Performance Platform, formerly known as AppFolio Property Manager, without a date; answers that merely use the name AppFolio Property Manager were treated as name mentions and not coded, and no dated rename was available to class against (the newsroom was not read within the cap). C39 splits the Claude sentence on Realm-X: the assistant part is wrong because Core lists Realm-X Assistant & Messages, while the Flows part is true and sits in C32. Mere name mentions, positioning (unit ranges served, best for), ratings, G2 rankings, AI performance statistics, support complaints and hedged lines were not coded. The full answer text was also read for AppFolio-headed sections and the AppFolio column of the q7 comparison tables, which the passages file omits. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot exists for AppFolio and no page was blocked or thin; the other snapshots were searched again for iOS, Android, cloud, per-unit pricing, a free trial and the five named partners, and none settles a claim, so nothing was re-classed.
